scheduled_work_units.successor_rule: Routine closed acquisition days continue to the next quota-day wake-up. Provider time-window rate limiting becomes BARBECUE_SEARCH_HOLD_RATE_LIMIT and fails closed. Confirmed daily quota exhaustion preserves the inherited provider-capacity safe-close/hold distinction. Review backlog fails closed. BARBECUE_TECHNIQUE_CORPUS_PILOT_PASS retires recurring pilot acquisition into a separately bounded closeout/expansion decision and never auto-publishes or auto-admits content.
scheduled_work_units.retirement_rule: When BARBECUE_TECHNIQUE_CORPUS_PILOT_PASS or a hard hold makes recurring acquisition ineligible, persisted work-unit state must mark HOLD_OR_RETIRE; the schedule cannot silently cross into expansion, publication, app admission or Knowledge Core promotion.

preflight_contract: verify owner-confirmed assigned Search limit, 90-call routine ceiling and protected reserve

retired_work_units.successor_rule: Routine closed days, including near-ceiling provider-quota safe-closes, continue to the next quota-day wake-up without replay. Confirmed daily quota exhaustion and provider time-window rate limiting are distinct: materially early daily quota exhaustion becomes a policy/quota hold, while rateLimitExceeded becomes DAILY_SEARCH_HOLD_RATE_LIMIT. A durable hard hold stops live Search until its explicit resolution contract is satisfied. YT_CUL_6_READINESS_EARNED hands off to a separately bounded YT-CUL-6 readiness reconciliation and never auto-authorizes Atlas promotion, app admission or publication.
retired_work_units.retirement_rule: When a hard hold or YT-CUL-6 readiness makes recurring live discovery ineligible, the persisted work-unit state must mark the scheduler HOLD_OR_RETIRE. The cron may remain only as a fail-closed no-live-spend wake-up until a bounded repository change removes, replaces or re-authorizes it.
